findings.text: Pulse.id documents its composite as facility:archive:external_identity, but the class has no external_identity slot (its identity slot is name, at facility.yaml:1756), and the only worked example, tests/graph/test_archive_schema.py:27-30, builds the id from the last path component of DEMO:CAMPAIGN/commissioning-alpha. That key is not injective: DEMO:CAMPAIGN/alpha and DEMO:OTHER/alpha would both yield demo:codac_uda:slow:alpha and MERGE onto one graph node. The next section's scanner will copy whichever convention the landed example shows.

_host_key re-declares the operator-exclusion host comparison that scripts/codac_uda_prototype/reader.py:23 already owns for the same policy, and the two disagree on IP addresses: the prototype's key for 192.0.2.10 is the prefix 192, while this one compares addresses exactly. Two enforcement paths for one exclusion rule now answer differently for the same host set, so a reader adopting one cannot be sure the other agrees.

The fragment directs connection callers to pass the merged public/private data-system block to resolve_archive_endpoint, but _deep_merge at imas_codex/discovery/base/facility.py:71 replaces a list wholesale. A private file supplying only hosts for the existing archives therefore drops the operator role, and validate_codac_uda_config then refuses with 'operator archive must be explicitly excluded', a policy message answering what is a merge-shape problem. The private block must redeclare all three roles.

notes: Read goal, done_when and write_paths from the run's dispatch record; the manifest from the run directory; both commits of the diff against their base; the five gate logs; and plan section 3 at docs/plans/codac-uda-signals.html:62-63.
